Read one RAB file

Source: R/utils_aircraft.R
read_aircraft_file.Rd

Reads a monthly RAB file and makes the layouts ANAC has used comparable: the registration mark column is always MARCAS (it was MARCA until early 2026), empty cells and the text "null" become NA, and quotes escaped as "" inside a field (used in the JSON owner and operator columns) are un-escaped.

Usage

read_aircraft_file(path, showProgress = FALSE)

Arguments

path

String. Local file path. The file name must be yyyy-mm.csv.

showProgress

Logical. Defaults to TRUE display progress.

Value

A data.table with raw (upper case) column names and a reference_date column.
